incremental_value: None demonstrated. B gives the more faithful property explanation.

property: Eames House / Case Study House No. 8
A: A 1949 California residence and studio using industrial components in a hillside setting.
B: Standardized construction and a densely personal collection of objects coexist here. Its appeal is warmer and more experimental than a generic steel-and-glass minimalism label suggests. Herman Miller, Vitra, MoMA, Powers of Ten, film/photography and Case Study architecture are predictable leads. A recommendation of those names alone adds little.
C: The input is Eames Foundation at the verified house address. On the shared home-goods panel it favors Hem, Fritz Hansen, Eames Office, VITRA and KNOLL. Friedman Benda is the second cultural-place recommendation and stays second for the related Ray-author input and half-place panel. A primary exhibition record corroborates an Eames furniture connection. Books are largely contemporary poetry; their relevance to the house is unverified.
incremental_value: Strongest narrow discovery case: one corroborated, stable lead absent from B. Not proof an LLM could not find it. The brand-vector correlation with Ray author is negative, so house/design-author proxies are not interchangeable.

property: Cedar Hill / Frederick Douglass National Historic Site
A: A mid-19th-century Washington house enlarged to 21 rooms.
B: Its significance principally follows Douglass’s life, writing and political history rather than a canonical architect. Literature, abolitionist history and African American history institutions are predictable connections. The distinction matters: a cultural history visitor is not thereby a buyer of this architectural style. No demographic or demand inference follows.
C: The historic-site input gives brands such as Black Wall Street App, The Lip Bar and D’IYANU. In the shared home-goods panel Casper, Sleep Number and GE Appliances lead. This differs from the architecture museums but does not distinguish historical identity, visitor culture and building style.
incremental_value: No additional property-specific explanation demonstrated. Do not infer visitor or buyer demographics from brand names, or turn historic significance into a price premium.
